name: vibecodus-maximus
description: Claude Code writes drafts as ghost text behind your code. You type them. Only what you type gets committed.

commands.title: Show Claude draft side by side
Jump to next line to type
Discard Claude draft for this file
Recover my files after interrupted Claude turn
Ask Claude about the ghost code here
Enable ghost mode in this folder
Disable ghost mode in this folder (remove hooks)
Mark baseline (before running another AI tool)
Ghostify changes (turn AI edits into ghost code)

vibeGhost.blockPaste.description: Undo pastes (or AI completions) that copy a chunk straight out of Claude's draft.

vibeGhost.autoEnable.description: Turn ghost mode on automatically in every git repo you open: wires Claude Code hooks (.claude/settings.local.json), .gitignore and a pre-commit guard. Opt a folder out with "Ghost: Disable ghost mode in this folder".

vibeGhost.askLens.description: Show "💬 Ask Claude about this" above each ghost part.

vibeGhost.askWithSessionContext.description: Fork your latest Claude Code session in this folder for questions, so Claude remembers why it wrote the draft. Your terminal session is not modified.

vibeGhost.askModel.description: Model for questions (e.g. sonnet, haiku). Empty = Claude Code default.

vibeGhost.pasteThreshold.description: Minimum characters (whitespace squashed) before a paste counts as copying the draft.
